single_cell.source: Bioconductor ExperimentHub EH2259, Kang18_8vs8; provider ind/stim/cell annotations
single_cell.package_example_limitation: muscat example_sce has only two paired donors; retain as ingestion example, not nonzero deletion benchmark
single_cell.cells: provider multiplets == singlet only; preserve all annotated cell types and all source genes
single_cell.aggregation: exact donor + condition + cell-type sums; min_cells 10
single_cell.native_transform: log2(CPM + 1), frozen before donor deletion; all source features define library totals
single_cell.model_feature_filter: total count >=10 and count >=1 in at least 3 included pseudobulks; frozen baseline universe
single_cell.identity: public provider donor IDs; raw genotype identity NOT_EVALUATED

proteomics.units: six technical measurement runs, three per spike-in condition; not six independent patients
proteomics.frozen_filter: exclude Reverse, Potential contaminant, Only identified by site flagged +; retain proteins with finite positive intensity in all six runs
proteomics.transform: log2 supplied MaxQuant Intensity; no imputation or additional normalization
proteomics.scope: protein/run-deletion numeric robustness benchmark; no donor-level inference, spike-in detection superiority or biomarker claim
